heroHeadline: RSF Drone Strikes Al Dabbah Power Station; 22 Killed in Saraf Omra — SAF Captures Dibebad Crossroads in South Kordofan as Multi-Front Offensive Continues
heroSubtitle: On Day 1135, RSF drones struck the Al Dabbah power station in Northern State (3 injured, widespread blackouts), extending the RSF's demonstrated long-range drone reach to SAF's deep rear for the second time in two months. A drone strike on Saraf Omra, North Darfur — attribution contested between SAF and RSF — killed 22 people and wounded 17, the second mass-casualty attack on the town since March. On May 23, SAF captured Dibebad (Ed Dubeibat), the 'Tayba Triangle' strategic crossroads in South Kordofan linking northern, western, and southern Kordofan supply routes; IOM documented 565 households displaced. A SAF airstrike on an RSF-SPLM-N supply convoy near Yabus, Blue Nile State killed 5 and injured 20. These developments continue Sudan's May 2026 trajectory of SAF ground gains (White Nile State cleared May 22, Dilling siege broken May 20, Wadi al-Atrun captured May 19) running in parallel with intensifying drone warfare on both sides. Total displacement remains 14 million+; 19.5 million face acute food insecurity as the June–August lean-season peak approaches.
